items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: We traveled all over with her, with that show.

ctx.x: - it was featuring her. Naturally, at the time she was just going on Joe's name. Because she couldn't do nothin'. Shit, she couldn't sing. She was just pretty, thousand dollar gowns and all that stuff. In those days women wanted to see her. "I'm going to see Marva Louis. I want to see one of them pretty gowns she has? Did you see her last night?" We played the Howard Theatre. We traveled all over with her, with that show.

When that show was over, when we got off the road, we went to Philadelphia, and stayed at Philadelphia three months at a club called Shangalai(?) Club. We went there, and we stayed there for... Marva wasn't with the show then. She'd left. We stayed up there from December until March.
